title: Trump and Zelensky clash in televised Oval Office meeting
body:
On 28 February 2025, US President Donald Trump and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky met in the Oval Office of the White House in Washington, D.C. The meeting ran from about 11:20 to 13:42 EST and was broadcast live. It had been expected to end with the signing of the Ukraine-US Mineral Resources Agreement. Vice President JD Vance, Secretary of State Marco Rubio, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent attended for the United States.

The exchange turned confrontational after a Polish reporter asked about concerns that Trump was aligning too closely with Putin and Vance answered by praising diplomacy. Zelensky replied by reviewing the war since 2014 and asked Vance what kind of diplomacy he meant. Vance called it "disrespectful" for Zelensky to argue the issue in front of the media. Trump told Zelensky he was "gambling with World War Three" and said, "make a deal or we're out." Zelensky answered, "I'm very serious ... I'm the president in a war."

Trump cancelled the planned joint news conference and the minerals signing, and Zelensky's motorcade left the White House at 13:42. According to the source, the administration suspended military aid on 3 March and intelligence sharing within a week, and both resumed on 11 March after talks in Jeddah. Nearly all US allies voiced support for Zelensky, and he later attended a summit with European leaders in London.
